mapper.select: SELECT * FROM ( SELECT pr.product_id, pr.name AS product_name, b.brand_id, b.name AS brand_name, pr.image_url, pr.product_url FROM place pl JOIN brand b ON b.brand_id = pl.brand_id JOIN product pr ON pr.brand_id = b.brand_id WHERE pl.navigation_key = #{navigationKey} AND pr.image_url IS NOT NULL AND pr.product_url IS NOT NULL ORDER BY pr.sort_order, pr.product_id ) WHERE ROWNUM <= #{limit}
